evidence: We used the 1,000-tweet dataset by BIBREF2 that contains the named-entities labels and entity-level sentiments for each of the four 2016 presidential primary candidates Bernie Sanders, Donald Trump, Hillary Clinton, and Ted Cruz, provided by crowdworkers, and by experts in political communication, whose labels are considered groundtruth. The crowdworkers were located in the US and hired on the BIBREF22 platform. For the task of entity-level sentiment analysis, a 3-scale rating of "negative," "neutral," and "positive" was used by the annotators.
